notes: Added one new country: Italy (SISSA Trieste and University of Rome Tor Vergata).
SISSA: written PhD entrance exams 1989–2026 for Geometry & Mathematical Physics and for Mathematical Analysis, Modelling & Applications; the English version is used when both languages exist.
Tor Vergata: written PhD admission exams 2023–2025 (39th–41st cycles).
Every imported URL returned HTTP 200 and a real %PDF- signature from the official domain. SISSA mathLab rows reuse the AMMA files (not duplicated) and MSc-course exams were excluded.
Other Italian math PhD programmes checked (Pisa, SNS, Padova, Milano, Bologna, Sapienza…) select by CV and interview and publish no written exams.
